title: Terraqua Chests
intro: Terraqua Chests can be bought for 29 diamonds. They were introduced on March 13th, 2023 and contain pieces for Terrarium and Aquarium Houses. Puzzle pieces found in Terraqua Chests might also be found in the Prize Wheel. The Premium and VIP passes for Season 4 of the Season Pass included Terraqua Chests among their rewards. There are NO animals in the Terraqua Chests.
content_note: Note: Only items with confirmed rarity descriptions are listed here.
